notes.title: The Last of Waifus 100 keys giveaway launching NOW!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35694047/a56cf7f75b4e5a4d62dd45b65e2916eddcae5097.png[/img]

To celebrate the release of our newest game The Last of Waifus launching on [b]Monday, 10th of August [/b]this year, we want to give [b]100 keys to 100 lucky winners[/b].

[h1]How to enter:[/h1]
[olist]
[*] Wishlist & Follow [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1359650/The_Last_of_Waifus/]The Last of Waifus [/url]

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35694047/a0b38d5b55c67382723cc8c5f7e7fb26a7c4a605.gif[/img]

[*] Follow [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/35694047]Konnichiwa Games [/url] Developer Page

[*] [b]Share this announcement[/b] with your friends

Click the [b]"Share"[/b] button under this post, choose [b]"Share directly to my status"[/b] and post with your own comment.

[*] [b]Write a comment under this post[/b] to let us know you are participating
[/olist]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1359650/The_Last_of_Waifus/

We will [b]announce the winners[/b] on Monday, 10th of August in [b]"The Last of Waifus giveaway results"[/b] announcement — so stay tuned and do not miss out! 

We wish you the [b]best luck[/b]!

[h1]Cheers, 
Konnichiwa Games[/h1]

notes.title: The Last of Waifus: new game coming soon!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/2OzlAF4.gif[/img]

We want to announce our new game: [b]The Last of Waifus.[/b] Fight the Infected, clear out the city, enjoy your Waifu!


The game will be release in mid July, more info soon..

[h3]Add The Last of Waifus to your Wishlist and be the first one in line!
[/h3]
